item.title: Daily Personal Podcast — 2026-04-30
item.description:
Daily Personal Podcast — 2026-04-30

Duration: 23:01 · Listen (mp3)

02-ai-news

  • Tencent open-sources Hy-MT1.5-1.8B at 1.25-bit, fits 33-language translation in 440 MB on a phone (source)
  • Anthropic's BioMysteryBench — Claude Mythos Preview claims expert-level bioinformatics, with honest caveats (source)
  • Stanford's "Recursive Multi-Agent Systems" tops Hugging Face daily papers with concrete agent-orchestration gains (source)
  • White House blocks Anthropic's plan to widen Mythos access to ~70 more orgs (source)

03-markets

  • Apple reports Q2 FY26 after the close tonight — first print since Cook succession announcement (source)
  • Hyperscaler capex blowout — MSFT $190B, GOOGL ~$190B, META up to $145B, AMZN $43B in Q1 alone (source)
  • Fed holds at 3.50–3.75% in 8–4 split; Powell's likely final meeting; 10Y jumps to 4.42% (source)
  • March PCE prints this morning into a hawkish-leaning Fed (source)

04-government

  • FISA Section 702 set to expire at midnight as Senate, House remain at impasse (source)
  • FCC adopts Report and Order modernizing satellite spectrum sharing (source)
  • Supreme Court guts Voting Rights Act Section 2 in Louisiana redistricting case (source)

05-frontier-tech

  • Intellia's lonvo-z hits 87% attack-rate cut in HAELO — first Phase 3 win ever for an in-vivo CRISPR therapy (source)
  • FDA approves Otarmeni — first gene therapy for genetic hearing loss (source)
  • Greater Bay Tech rolls A-sample all-solid-state cells — claims 260–500 Wh/kg with 2–3C charge (source)
  • Waymo opens Miami and Orlando to the public, adds highway driving (source)
  • Oklo lands first NRC license and DOE safety agreement (source)

06-video-games

  • Housemarque's Saros launches today as the studio's highest-rated game ever — but reviews call it "cosmic horror" (source)
  • Insider says Naughty Dog is building a new Uncharted alongside Intergalactic (source)
  • inKONBINI launches today, day-one on Game Pass, with strong cozy-narrative reviews (source)
